experienceGoal.playerProblem: 自動戦闘の最中、現在の技名が短いイベント表示として消え、序破急のどこを進行しているかを継続して結び付けて読みにくい。
experienceGoal.targetState: 交戦中は現在のnative技と序破急phaseが常時ひとまとまりで読め、進行済みphaseも一目で追える。
successSignals: 交戦中、現在の技名がイベント消失後も序・破・急のphase付きで読める。
phaseが進むと完了済み段階と現在段階を視覚的に区別でき、間合い状態では技を捏造しない。

rootCauses.observationEvidence: Immutable Before 03-play-04 shows active combat and a recent incoming contact, but no current technique name remains visible; the persistent line only says 自動戦闘 · スワイプで間合い.
rootCauses.sourceEvidence: skill-name receives p.skill from native fight state, but is visually clipped; flow only pushes action changes into a 2700ms transient entry.
rootCauses.prediction: Projecting existing skill-name plus active phase into a persistent read-only label keeps current intent legible without touching combat authority.
rootCauses.falsifier: Displayed technique differs from native action/phase, or a technique is invented while measuring distance.

rootCauses.observationEvidence: Immutable Before combat screenshots show 序破急 as low-salience labels; transition pulses are momentary and leave no progress trail.
rootCauses.sourceEvidence: syncCombatSequence already supplies authoritative active phase; Demon presentation has no completed-phase trail.
rootCauses.prediction: A presentation-only trail derived from current native phase makes sequence continuity readable without changing transitions.
rootCauses.falsifier: Completed styling appears ahead of current phase or survives combat reset.

workItems.summary: Keep current native technique visible with its authored phase while combat is active.
workItems.evidence: Pure label projection plus immutable candidate native-combat screenshot.
workItems.expectedPlayerFacingEffect: Current automatic action remains readable after transient feed entries fade.

workItems.summary: Mark phases before the current authoritative phase as completed and strengthen the current phase, clearing on combat end.
workItems.evidence: Leaf assertions plus immutable candidate screenshots across native phase progression.
workItems.expectedPlayerFacingEffect: Sequence direction and current position can be read continuously.

observation.summary: Pinned native play completed two combats and two captures. Candidate problems were combat sequence continuity, post-capture world occlusion, return spatial guidance, and lineage density. Sequence continuity was selected because fresh combat evidence shows attrition/contact state while current technique/phase continuity disappears between transient events.

conditions.route: armed brand tap > begin > native steering > idle combat/devour > pause > lineage

doNotRetryRespected: Do not repeat combat attrition/contact ownership from PR #1415.
Do not treat DOM/test presence as visual evidence.

hypothesis.cause: Authoritative action and phase exist but persistent presentation only keeps generic control copy while action transitions fade.
hypothesis.prediction: Joining native action+phase in a persistent label and deriving a completed trail makes authored sequence progress readable without changing Tidebreak/input.
hypothesis.falsifier: Candidate mislabels phase/action, invents action during measure, obscures vitals/guide, or leaves stale trail after combat.

candidates.reason: Small causal presentation change using existing authority.
Duplicates Tidebreak state and risks a second authority.

implementation.summary: Demon-only read-side flow label and phase trail; no combat, input, capture, extraction, save, shared sequence authority or workflow change.

limitations: Fresh native timing may not expose every phase in screenshots; notVerified stays explicit.
